subject: Security qualification & incident notification plan — next steps (CareBridge)
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Ava Morrison <ava.morrison@carebridge.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-04T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: Recap + security/IR asks from today's call — Redwood x CareBridge

Hi Ava — thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap and a few asks so we can move the evaluation to security/procurement: 

1) SOC 2 status: you mentioned an in-progress Type II engagement — can you confirm current evidence we can share with our Security review (latest report or assertion, and expected completion date)?

2) Data protection: you highlighted PHI flows for a subset of customers. Please confirm whether CareBridge signs a BAA and point us to the HIPAA controls mapping or policies.

3) IR & breach notification: our security team needs formal timelines for detection/notification and an example incident playbook or BCP summary. Can you provide your standard breach notification SLA (e.g., T+X hours) and any documented escalation paths?

4) Vendor RFI: to speed review, I've attached our vendor RFI — if you can fill the fields you own (especially IR timeline fields) that would be ideal.

Next steps I propose: you share the SOC2/BCP artifacts and the partially-completed RFI by EOD Friday; we'll route to our InfoSec (Neha) and SRE (Ben) for a quick read. If anything is sensitive, please mark as Confidential and send via the Drive link below.

Drive link: https://drive.redwood.com/shared/CareBridge-security-pack

Appreciate it — Jordan

--
Jordan Blake
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0124
From: Ava Morrison <ava.morrison@carebridge.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Reyes <tom.reyes@carebridge.com>, IT Security <sec-team@carebridge.com>
Date: 2026-10-04T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Recap + security/IR asks from today's call — Redwood x CareBridge

Thanks Jordan — great meeting. Quick answers inline: 

1) SOC 2: CareBridge completed a Type I SOC 2 in 2024 (attached). Type II is currently in progress with a target completion of 2027-02-28. We can share interim control evidence (control PDFs & control owner attestations) now; the SOC2 Type I (2024) is attached for context.

2) HIPAA / BAA: CareBridge is a HIPAA-covered entity for the modules that touch PHI. We do sign BAAs; our legal team has a standard BAA template.

3) IR & breach notification: Our internal target is detection within 24 hours, initial notification to customers within 72 hours of confirmed breach, and a full incident report within 30 days. Attached is a high-level BCP/DR overview. Note: time-to-notify depends on regulatory obligations for affected customers.

4) Vendor RFI: attached a partially completed RFI (we filled infra/network and identity sections). We'll coordinate with IT Security to finish the IR fields.

Attachments: CareBridge_SOC2_TypeI_2024.pdf; BCP-DR-Overview.xlsx; CareBridge_Vendor_RFI_Partial.pdf

I'll aim to get the completed RFI IR section by Wednesday. If you need anything earlier, loop Tom (procurement) or Sec team.

Best,
Ava Morrison
Director of Partnerships | CareBridge Health
ava.morrison@carebridge.com | +1 617-555-2201
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Ava Morrison <ava.morrison@carebridge.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-05T08:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Recap + security/IR asks from today's call — Redwood x CareBridge

Hi Ava — thanks for the quick turnaround and for the attachments. A couple of clarifying questions from InfoSec so we can complete our intake: 

- Can you confirm whether detection within 24 hours is measured from your monitoring systems or from reported user/customer alerts? (we often audit detection metrics and need the measurement point)
- For the 72-hour initial notification, does that include notifying regulators where applicable, or is that strictly customer notification? Please specify any regional differences (e.g., EU GDPR timelines you apply).
- Do you currently maintain a documented IR playbook that maps roles (CISO, Legal, Communications) with contact lists? If so, can you share a redacted example (PII removed) or the table of responsibilities.

Also flagging one procurement item to Laura: we'll want the BAA template and a summary of any contract terms that typically require negotiation (data retention, deletion windows, subprocessor lists).

If you prefer, we can set a short 30-min session this week to walk through the RFI IR section with your security team.

Thanks — Neha
Neha Kapoor
Security & Compliance, Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.com
From: Tom Reyes <tom.reyes@carebridge.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Ava Morrison <ava.morrison@carebridge.com>
Date: 2026-10-05T12:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Recap + security/IR asks from today's call — Redwood x CareBridge

Laura / Jordan — procurement note from my side: we've initiated an internal NDA so we can exchange some of the redacted IR artifacts. I'll send a DocuSign link for the mutual NDA; once executed we'll share the full BCP/DR document and subprocessor list.

DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/mb/CB-NDA-2026

Also, if Redwood has a standard BAA, please attach it to the HubSpot deal; otherwise we can start with our template.

Regards,
Tom Reyes

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>

Date: 2026-10-06T16:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Recap + security/IR asks from today's call — Redwood x CareBridge

Appreciate the quick answers and the attachments, Ava & Tom. Confirming next steps from Redwood's side: 

- Neha / Ben will review the attached SOC1/Type I and BCP overview and follow up with 2–3 specific evidence requests by Tuesday.
- We'll accept the DocuSign NDA; Jordan to watch for Tom's link and route to legal.
- Please prioritize the IR timeline fields in the RFI — if you can mark whether detection/initial-notify/full-report are 'measured' vs 'target' we'll note that distinction in our review.
- Laura, we'll share our standard BAA draft into the HubSpot deal by EOD Monday so you can compare with CareBridge's template.

Would like to propose a 30-min technical sync on Wednesday 10/13 to go through the RFI IR section with your Sec team. Ava — if that works, please confirm attendees and preferred time window.

Thanks — Jordan
--
Jordan Blake
